title: The chemical composition analysis of Yixin Tongmai Granules using UHPLC-MS/MS and exploration of its potential mechanism in treatment of coronary artery disease based on network pharmacology and molecular docking.
one_liner_zh: 该文用UHPLC-MS/MS分析中药成分，结合网络药理学和分子对接探索治疗冠心病的机制，虽涉及蛋白靶点对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Yixin Tongmai Granules (YTG) is a popular Chinese herbal granules for the treatment of coronary artery disease (CAD), but its molecular pharmacological mechanism is still unclear. This article explores the mechanism of CAD treatment from the perspective of network pharmacology. We analyzed the chemical composition of YTG using UHPLC-MS/MS and identified 131 ingredients. The relative drug content of 33 ingredients exceeded 0.5%. These ingredients were further screened using the SwissADME platform with ADME criteria. Using the HIT database and SwissTargetPrediction platform, high probability targets for these ingredients were generated. Using Venn Diagram, 96 effective targets associated with CAD were identified, involving 14 core ingredients. This study imported these effective targets into the STRING platform and obtained the core targets through network topology analysis: TP53, STAT3, transcription factor Jun, MAPK3, MAPK1, AKT1, SRC, MYC, BCL2, transcription factor p65, TNF, and ESR2. Then enrichment analysis with Metascape platform indicated that, in the system network of YTG in anti-CAD, the principal pathways are "Lipid and Atherosclerosis", "Pathways in cancer", and "AGE-RAGE signaling pathway in diabetic complications." Next, the affinities between the core ingredients and their associated core targets were examined individually through molecular docking. Finally, based on deep mining of PubMed literature, this study investigated the relationship between each core target and CAD, the relationship between each core target and its associated core ingredients, and inferred the main pharmacological ingredients of YTG, namely Tanshinone IIA, Cryptotanshinone, Caffeic acid, Denshensu, Ononin, and Formononetin.
abstract_zh: 益心通脉颗粒（YTG）是一种用于治疗冠状动脉疾病（CAD）的常用中药颗粒，但其分子药理学机制尚不明确。本文从网络药理学的角度探讨其治疗CAD的机制。我们采用UHPLC-MS/MS分析了YTG的化学成分，鉴定出131种成分。其中33种成分的相对药物含量超过0.5%。利用SwissADME平台，根据ADME标准对这些成分进行了进一步筛选。通过HIT数据库和SwissTargetPrediction平台，生成了这些成分的高概率靶点。使用维恩图（Venn Diagram），确定了与CAD相关的96个有效靶点，涉及14种核心成分。本研究将这些有效靶点导入STRING平台，并通过网络拓扑分析获得核心靶点：TP53、STAT3、转录因子Jun、MAPK3、MAPK1、AKT1、SRC、MYC、BCL2、转录因子p65、TNF和ESR2。随后，利用Metascape平台进行富集分析，结果表明，在YTG抗CAD的系统网络中，主要通路为“脂质与动脉粥样硬化”、“癌症通路”和“糖尿病并发症中的AGE-RAGE信号通路”。接下来，通过分子对接逐一检查了核心成分与其相关核心靶点之间的亲和力。最后，基于对PubMed文献的深入挖掘，本研究探讨了每个核心靶点与CAD的关系、每个核心靶点与其相关核心成分的关系，并推断出YTG的主要药理成分，即丹参酮IIA、隐丹参酮、咖啡酸、丹参素、芒柄花苷和芒柄花素。
